findings.claim: The production gateway composes the projector with ConfiguredLogBroker, but the new required high-water capability is only implemented for IggyBroker, so the projector will fail readiness/startup through the default LogBroker::head_offset error.
findings.evidence: entity_projection_runtime::start constructs `EntityProjector::new(broker, Arc::clone(&store))` with `broker: Arc<ConfiguredLogBroker>`; EntityProjector::run_until_shutdown calls `self.broker.head_offset(...)`; `crates/frf-ports/src/log_broker.rs` adds a default `head_offset` implementation returning `PortError::Transport("broker does not expose a channel high-water offset")`; the diff only adds an override in `crates/frf-broker-iggy/src/broker.rs` for `IggyBroker` and contains no change to `crates/frf-gateway/src/configured_broker.rs` to delegate it.
findings.suggested_fix: Implement `LogBroker::head_offset` on `ConfiguredLogBroker` and delegate to the wrapped Iggy broker, and add a gateway-level test that uses ConfiguredLogBroker rather than IggyBroker directly.
